captionStarter: Steelers 24-21 over Vikings in Dublin, the first NFL game ever played in Ireland.
concept: Quick hit: Steelers' 24-6 lead shrinking into a nail-biter by the final whistle at Croke Park
description: The Pittsburgh Steelers beat the Minnesota Vikings 24-21 in Dublin, the first regular-season NFL game played in Ireland, after leading 24-6 before a late Vikings rally.
headline: Steelers hold off Vikings in first-ever NFL game in Ireland
